2014_spells.greater-invisibility.descrip: You or a creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person.
2014_spells.greater-invisibility.effectS: Make a creature invisible until it attacks or the spell ends
2014_spells.greater-invisibility.fullDes: Using 1 action, you or a creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person. You or a creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
